title: Interaction: two buys each affordable alone, jointly exceed buying power
instruction: buy $6,000 of AAPL and $6,000 of MSFT
notes: Margin account, buying_power 10000.00. Equity is 50000.00 because the account also holds SPY (100 sh @ 400.00 = 40000.00, long held, untouched by this basket) -- purely to keep the concentration cap out of this test: cap is 15% of 50000.00 = 7500.00, and each 6000.00 buy (6000/50000 = 12%) fits under it individually, so R3 never fires and this stays a true R1-only interaction case. Each order alone (6000.00 AAPL, 6000.00 MSFT) is individually under buying_power (6000 < 10000), so a system that checks orders in isolation would wrongly ALLOW both. Checked at basket level, the combined notional is 6000.00 + 6000.00 = 12000.00, which exceeds buying_power by 2000.00 -- R1 must fire against the SUM across the basket, not either order alone. BLOCKING, no repair (see case_009's reasoning), zero orders reach the broker. This case exists specifically to punish per-order checking.
